o.text: Borrowed from Ottoman Turkish وافتیس or from Turkish vaftiz. Ultimately from Ancient Greek βάπτισμα (báptisma).
From Georgian ბალახი (balaxi), Ingilo dialect ბალახ (balax).
From Proto-Turkic *bẹŕ- (“to shiver, tremble; to hate, be bored, feel aversion”). Cognate with Turkish bezmek, etc.
Internationalism; via Russian вакцина (vakcina) or French vaccin.
